subject.title: [Feature]: Support OpenAI GPT-Live (gpt-live-1) full-duplex realtime voice models

question: Should the bundled OpenAI provider support the alpha quicksilver protocol before the public GPT-Live API stabilizes, and if so should selection be inferred from `gpt-live-*` model names or exposed as an explicit early-access protocol setting?
rationale: The wire shape and implementation boundary are supported by source evidence, but accepting pre-GA compatibility burden and choosing the user-facing selection contract require maintainer intent.

options.title: Wait for public contract
options.body: Keep GA Realtime support and add a clear unsupported-model diagnostic until OpenAI publishes a stable GPT-Live developer contract.

options.title: Infer from model family
options.body: Treat `gpt-live-*` as WebRTC-only quicksilver sessions while preserving the existing model-only configuration experience.

options.title: Add explicit early access
options.body: Introduce a documented provider-owned quicksilver protocol selector with unstable early-access status and focused upgrade tests.

recommendation.title: Wait for public contract
recommendation.body: Keep GA Realtime support and add a clear unsupported-model diagnostic until OpenAI publishes a stable GPT-Live developer contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The realtime provider history and current issue ownership signal make him the strongest available owner for the pre-GA product-contract decision.
